BUNSHIN NO JUTSU
(DUPLICATION TECHNIQUE)

• Ninjutsu Rank E
• Action: Movement or Standard (see text)
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Sustained
• Chakra Cost: 1 or 4 (see text)

Creates one or two illusory clones of the character. Regardless of the number of clones
created, the user will always spend 1 chakra point to execute the technique.


Clones are merely images; that is, they serve only to confuse the enemy. They cannot
use jutsus or maneuvers, nor can they cause damage to the opponent. When the clones
are touched by any creature or object, the effect of the jutsu ends. Clones possess all
combat actions, but they do not have initiative and act on the same turn as the user.
You can use the Bunshin no Jutsu to feint your opponent, making them move around the
battlefield to confuse the enemy or feigning attacks. Doing so increases the technique's
duration to a standard action and the chakra cost to 4. You make a Sleight of Hand roll
against the enemy's Readiness. If successful, the opponent is feinted.

Counter your next melee attack or projectile throw. If used in this way, the clones cannot
perform other actions and disappear shortly after the user's attack.

HENGE NO JUTSU
(TRANSFORMATION TECHNIQUE)

• Ninjutsu Rank E
• Action: Movement
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Sustained
• Chakra Cost: 1

It allows the user to transform into another person, changing their appearance. This jutsu
can also be used to transform into an animal or object of the same size category as the
user.

The character does not make a test to use the Henge no Jutsu. However, anyone who
interacts with them while they are transformed will be entitled to a Perception test, with
a Difficulty equal to 7 + the user's Disguise skill level. If successful, the person will notice
some minor flaw in the transformation and will know that it is someone using the Henge.



Henge can be used to camouflage small details on a character, such as scars, skin
blemishes, hair shape and color...
However, it is immediately canceled when it conflicts with the use of any technique.

KAI
- (RELEASE)

• Ninjutsu Rank D
Action : Standard
• Range: Touch
• Duration: Instantaneous
• Chakra Cost: Equal to the cost of the canceled Genjutsu
Hand Seals: No

This jutsu allows the user to free another person or themselves from a Genjutsu. In this
technique, the user makes a Spirit or Intelligence test against the resistance difficulty of the
Genjutsu to be canceled (without the reductions from successive Notice Genjutsu tests). The
chakra cost of the Kai technique is the same as the chakra cost of the Genjutsu to be canceled.



Using this technique on yourself requires no test or chakra cost, but you must have
previously succeeded in the genjutsu detection test (see Magen, p. 233). You can use
Kai even if the genjutsu has left you paralyzed, defenseless , or with your actions under
control or restriction.


The user can use the Kai technique to cancel their own jutsu, without needing to perform a
test or incur any chakra cost.

KAWARIMI NO JUTSU
(BODY REPLACEMENT TECHNIQUE)

• Ninjutsu Rank E / Shunjutsu
• Action: Movement
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Instantaneous
• Chakra Cost: 1
Hand seals: Optional.
This jutsu allows the user to quickly switch places with an object of approximately the
same size that is in the surrounding area or that they are carrying. The character can
also use handfuls of leaves, earth, stones, or sand if they don't have an object nearby at
the time of the substitution. Performing this at the moment of the opponent's attack
creates an optical illusion that makes them think the attack was successful. At that
moment, the user can take advantage of the opponent's distraction to attack them more
effectively or flee the battlefield.



Once per scene, the user can announce the use of Kawarimi as a defensive action,
consuming 1 chakra point, and completely avoiding the opponent's attack without any
test being required (neither by the attacker nor the defender). After doing so, the
opponent strikes the substitute body, while the user moves quickly in any direction,
maximizing their movement. The movement performed by Kawarimi does not generate
an opportune attack.


You can use Kawarimi against projectiles and regular attacks. You can also use it against
projectile-type techniques (such as the Cannon and Arrow effects) or melee techniques
(such as the Lightning Blade effect and the Rasengan).


It is not possible to use Kawarimi if you are caught off guard, feinted , or have movement
restrictions (such as being grabbed or impeded, for example). It is also not possible to
use it against area attacks.

If the Kawarimi is successful, the user gains the right to a resisted Stealth check against
the opponent's Readiness to hide somewhere within their movement range (which is
halved by the Stealth rules). Doing so requires a standard action, in addition to
camouflage or cover to hide. See more in the Stealth skill, p. 41.

KINOBORI
(TREE CLIMBING TECHNIQUE)

• Ninjutsu Rank E / Chakra Control
• Action: Free
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Continuous
• Chakra Cost: 1
Hand Seals: No

By concentrating chakra in their feet, the user is able to cling to any type of surface,
allowing them to walk on walls, climb trees by running up their trunks, or walk on the
ceiling upside down. The user consumes 1 chakra point, and the effects of Kinobori last
for the entire scene.


The user does not need to perform tests to walk on walls or ceilings, unless some
situation throws them off balance or causes them to lose concentration, in which case
an Athletics test is required to grab onto something or an Acrobatics test to regain
balance, depending on the situation.

SHUNSHIN NO JUTSU
(Instantaneous Movement Technique)

• Ninjutsu Rank D / Shunjutsu
• Action: Movement
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Instantaneous
• Chakra Cost: 1

The ninja's Instantaneous Movement Technique consists of super-fast movement that is
almost impossible to follow with the naked eye. To an ordinary person, it appears as if
the user...
as if he were teleporting. In reality, the character is charging his body with chakra and
moving at high speed.

In this technique, the user consumes 1 chakra point and can move up to their maximum
movement capacity. As a scene effect, leaves, smoke clouds, sand, or any other device can
be used by the character to enhance the jutsu. It is merely a show technique and does not
provide any advantage in combat, as any ninja can follow the user's movements.

TADAYOU
- (WALKING ON WATER)

• D Rank Ninjutsu / Chakra Control
• Action: Free
• Scope: Personal
• Duration: Continuous
• Chakra Cost: 1
Hand Seals: No

This technique allows the user to walk on water or any non-flammable or acidic liquid. Tests
for this technique are performed using the Spirit attribute, but are only necessary if a
situation throws the user off balance or out of concentration.
